positioning.oneLine: Local-first, evidence-first market intelligence and research for Hyperliquid.
positioning.description: A read-only research workstation under active development around byte-preserving source capture, a deterministic canonical ledger, reproducible analysis, and native Apple clients.

capabilities.claim: Defines an approved evidence-first architecture and staged implementation program.
Provides checked fixed-point domain primitives, versioned contracts, and deterministic synthetic fixtures.
Enforces local architecture, dependency, schema, provenance, and Stage 0 gate policies.
Defines validated byte-preserving source observations, explicit source failure policy, async source ports, and strict capture configuration.

limitations: The canonical public repository has not been created; this manifest is prepared for a future public preview.
The Stage 0 gate remains on HOLD and lacks required signed external evidence.
Real source adapters, durable spooling, canonical runtime, APIs, long-running services, research workflows, and native applications are not yet implemented.
No supported release, production deployment, benchmark, load, soak, restore, canary, or rollback qualification exists.
safetyBoundaries: V1 is read-only and contains no trading signer, exchange private-key handling, custody, order-placement route, or live execution service.
Public market feeds are provisional and cannot substitute for committed primary evidence.
Private alpha, operator-feed schemas, wallet labels, models, credentials, and deployment inventory remain outside the public export.
Research outputs are not guaranteed trading advice or a promise of profitability.
